topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: If an investment adviser manages your investment portfolio, they may charge you an ongoing annual fee based on the value of your portfolio.
answer: An investment advisory fee is a recurring charge an adviser may collect for managing your portfolio. It may be calculated based on the portfolio’s value. Because fees reduce the amount of money invested and earning a return, ongoing advisory fees can affect your portfolio over time. Review the fee disclosures and ask how the fee is calculated and what other charges may apply.
